documents.name: paper
documents.why: the large document: `@beltype/specimens` paper, four pages of running text, notes, a table, three variable faces

documents.name: cast
documents.why: a hand-written document with margin boxes, a page counter, a figure and a passed-through PNG

documents.name: cast-divided-row
documents.why: a table row divided across pages

documents.name: roads
documents.why: rotated text, a gradient with a soft mask, a radial shading, a spot ink with overprint, a CMYK ground, print marks with a bleed, a blurred shadow (the raster fallback), hyphenation, sub and superscript, internal and external links, `blackText: 100k`

documents.name: facsimile
documents.why: a page of another PDF, reopened by pdf-lib inside the writer

documents.name: webp
documents.why: a WebP, which the image pass decodes through the browser before the list

documents.name: arithmetic
documents.why: an arithmetic-coded JPEG, which the browser refuses to decode, so the image pass hands the file through

documents.name: photo
documents.why: an opaque 8-bit RGB PNG of 255 000 pixels, which the photo rule of the image pass re-encodes through the browser before the list

documents.name: faces
documents.why: a static TrueType face (Crimson Text Regular, `glyf`) and a static CFF face (Source Sans Pro Regular, `CFF `), neither variable nor unwrapped from WOFF2

documents.name: cff2
documents.why: a CFF2 variable face with `HVAR` (HarfBuzz's subset of Source Serif 4 Variable) at weight 700, away from its default master
documents.refused: caster: Source Serif 4 Variable#2|opsz=32,wght=700 glyph 1: layout used an advance of 635 but the embedded program's hmtx carries 645 after pinning {"wght":700,"opsz":32}

documents.name: images
documents.why: a CMYK JPEG with the Adobe marker, a JPEG with an ICC profile, and PNGs with alpha, Adam7 interlace, a palette with `tRNS`, 16 bits a sample, 16 bits with alpha and one grey channel

documents.name: facsimile-pages
documents.why: two pages of one facsimile file

documents.name: vectors
documents.why: an SVG marker (a form), `mix-blend-mode` inside `isolation: isolate` (an isolated group with a blend mode), an SVG `<mask>` (a soft mask), an `<hr>` (a `rect` item)

documents.name: pages
documents.why: a `--pdf-page-label` run with a prefix and a start (`/PageLabels`), an outline three levels deep, a link whose text wraps (two rectangles)
